column2: [intro]
I’m not here to dazzle or impress,
Big solos leave me quite perplexed.
I prefer jokes and funny faces,
Making people laugh is my favorite place.
I’m a quirky artist, it’s true,
Virtuosity’s never interested me, not a bit.
I’d rather have fun, be a little wild,
My little craziness makes me so cool and mild.
When I sing, it’s always outlandish,
Serious lyrics have never been my wish.
I prefer words that make you grin,
To make the crowds dance and spin.
I’m a quirky artist, it’s true,
Virtuosity’s never interested me, not a bit.
I’d rather have fun, be a little wild,
My little craziness makes me so cool and mild.
[ solo ]
So join me in this quirky dance,
Let’s ditch the norms, and take a chance.
For music’s all about joy and cheer,
And my little craziness makes us all feel near.
[outro]
